name: Warhammer Underworlds - Shadespire Edition (Classic)
short_description: Lead your fighters to Glory in the ultimate PvP dice-and-cards strategy combat game. Warhammer Underworlds - Shadespire Edition pits mighty warbands against one another in an eternal battle for glory in the realms of the Age of Sigmar.
detailed_description:
JOIN THE COMMUNITY

LEARN TO PLAY

About the Game*ALL WARBAND & COSMETIC DLC NOW INCLUDED IN THE MAIN GAME!*

Warhammer Underworlds – Shadespire Edition is a digital adaptation of the explosive, high-stakes, turn-based strategy tabletop game from Games Workshop that pits mighty warbands from the Age of Sigmar universe against one another in an eternal player versus player battle for Glory. Choose a warband, build your decks and carve a path to victory using dice-and-card mechanics that offer boundless strategic depth.

ASSEMBLE YOUR WARBANDTrapped within the towering spires of the Mirrored City of Shadespire, fourteen warbands battle it out for survival - each with unique abilities and a distinct combat style. All of these warbands are now available to play in online matches, bot matches or single-player challenges, having previously been available as DLC! 

Playable warbands:

Steelheart’s Champions - Magore's Fiends - Garrek’s Reavers - The Sepulchral Guard – Spiteclaw’s Swarm – The Farstriders – The Chosen Axes – Ironskull’s Boyz – Thorns of the Briar Queen – Eyes of the Nine – Drepur’s Wraithcreepers – The Storm of Celestus – Stormsire’s Cursebreakers – Mollog’s Mob

CRAFT YOUR DECKYour success is measured in Glory points - awarded for achieving objectives and vanquishing your foes. Deckbuilding is the strategic heart of Warhammer Underworlds – Shadespire Edition. Your 20-card power deck is filled with clever gambits, powerful upgrades, and cunning spells you’ll need to inflict maximum damage. Your 12-card objective deck will shape your tactical approach to a match, allowing you to score Glory by fulfilling specific conditions.

CLAIM THE SPOILS OF SHADESPIRE

A rewarding progression system in both online matches and single-player Challenges allows you to earn cosmetic content including warband skins, deck portraits, and player titles! Only those who have proven themselves in the unforgiving streets of Shadespire will be able to claim these rewards.

Warhammer Classics

Warhammer Classics is a collection of the greatest titles from the annals of Warhammer video game history, spanning the last 30 years, brought back to life as a series to celebrate their iconic legacy. 

Because of their classic nature, some of the content may not accurately reflect current depictions, lore, or presentation within the current Warhammer universes and settings
